description: IN-EPF-001 (ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21) — PF base capped at the ₹15,000 statutory wage ceiling. Basic=gross=₹20,000 (no HRA/allowances), so both the Code Wages add-back mechanism (dormant-by-default per shared.py, but currently enabled per shared._IN_CODE_WAGES_ENABLED_COUNTRIES) and the plain basic-only default agree the pre-ceiling PF base is ₹20,000 — capped at ₹15,000 by india.py's pf_wage_ceiling logic (also currently enabled). employee_pf = employer_pf (pre-diversion) = 15,000 × 12% = ₹1,800, matching the doc's own stated figures exactly.
source: ZP-TAX-IN-2026-27-001 §21 IN-EPF-001 + §9.1 (EPF wage ceiling ₹15,000, employee/employer rate 12%). Rate/ceiling supplied explicitly in this fixture rather than relying on hardcoded_defaults.py's own _IN_PF_WAGE_CEILING fallback, so the case is self-contained. Run through the real production engine (calculate_payroll) at authoring time.
